A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Hexus system/Legends|Hexus system]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. A squad of [[Tempest Zero/Legends|Tempest Zero]] starfighters, led by [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], attacked the Republic blockade of the system by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Aldanna]]. During the battle [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] was shot down by Tofen, who gained the upper hand on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. His squad was initially successful, but was forced to retreat when Republic reinforcements led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] had arrived.<ref name="TCW11" />
